title: Feedback That Backfires: Why Small Language Model Agents Repeat the Call They Just Watched Fail
abstract: arXiv:2608.23651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent harnesses record a failed tool call and its error message in the transcript and ask the model to continue, on the assumption that the error is corrective information. We measure whether it is. Defining the corrective gain of a failure record as the change in log-probability of re-emitting the action that just failed, we find the gain is negative for every instruction-tuned model we tested (6 checkpoints, 135M-1.7B, 4 families) in two environments: simulated tool calling and MBPP program repair. Normalised by action length the effect is about -1.03 nats per action token, a factor of 2.8 in the odds of each token, and holds on 90%-100% of individual items, not only on average. Over a fixed candidate set the probability of repeating the failed call rises from 0.06 to 0.54, and greedy decoding reproduces it token for token on 19% of items after the failure versus 0% before. Counterfactuals pairing the same call with a failure message

translated_title: 适得其反的反馈：为什么小型语言模型代理会重复刚刚目睹失败的调用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23651v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：代理框架在记录中记录失败的工具调用及其错误消息，并让模型继续，假设错误是纠正性信息。我们测量了这一点是否成立。将失败记录的纠正增益定义为重新发出刚失败动作的对数概率变化，我们发现，在模拟工具调用和MBPP程序修复两种环境中，我们测试的每个指令调整模型（6个检查点，135M-1.7B，4个家族）的增益均为负值。按动作长度标准化后，效果约为每个动作标记-1.03纳特，即每个标记的几率因子为2.8，并且在90%-100%的单个项目上成立，而不仅仅是平均情况。在固定候选集上，重复失败调用的概率从0.06上升到0.54，而贪婪解码在失败后19%的项目上逐字复现它，而失败前为0%。反事实配对相同的调用与失败消息。
tldr: 本研究发现，在小型语言模型代理中，记录并反馈失败的工具调用错误信息不仅不能纠正行为，反而显著增加了模型重复失败调用的概率，即反馈产生了适得其反的效果。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that in small language model agents, recording and feeding back failed tool call error messages not only fails to correct behavior but significantly increases the probability of repeating the failed call, indicating that the feedback backfires.
